Location: Melbourne CBD & Brunswick East, VIC

Employment type: Full-time, permanent (both positions)

Salary: $80,000 – $120,000 per annum plus superannuation, commensurate with role, skills and experience


Our clients operate a number of venues across Melbourne - Conferre Group (Tipo 00, Osteria Ilaria, Figlia and Grana). The venues are consistently recognised among Australia’s best, and we are known for premium dining service standards: genuine hospitality, refined table service, and deep food and wine knowledge.

Restaurant Manager

Our Clients are seeking an experienced Restaurant Manager to lead front-of-house operations within our group. The role involves ownership of the daily operation of a high-volume, premium dining restaurant and work closely with our chefs and senior leadership team.

Key duties and responsibilities

•Plan, organise and direct the daily operations of the restaurant, including service planning, reservations management and venue presentation to premium dining standards.

•Plan menus in consultation with chefs, and contribute to beverage and wine list programming with our sommeliers.

•Organise and supervise the delivery of exceptional table service; lead service on the floor during peak periods.

•Recruit, roster, train, develop and supervise front-of-house staff, and conduct performance reviews.

•Manage budgets, monitor wage and cost-of-goods targets, and maintain financial records including takings, ordering and stock control.

•Purchase and price goods according to budget; manage supplier relationships.

•Ensure compliance with liquor licensing, food safety, workplace health and safety, and all other regulatory requirements.

•Handle guest feedback and complaints with professionalism, and drive continuous improvement of the guest experience.

Skills and experience required

•A minimum of 2 years’ relevant full-time experience managing (or supervising at a senior level) a restaurant, preferably in a fine dining or premium dining environment.

•An AQF Diploma or higher qualification in hospitality management (or equivalent); at least 3 years of additional relevant experience may substitute for the formal qualification.

•Demonstrated leadership of large front-of-house teams in a high-volume service environment.

•Strong food and beverage knowledge, including wine; sommelier training highly regarded.

•Proven capability across rostering, budgeting, stock control and POS/reservation systems.

•A current Victorian RSA (or willingness to obtain before commencement); Food Safety Supervisor certification highly regarded.

Position 2 — Trade Waiter

Our clients are seeking a skilled Trade Waiter to deliver refined, premium dining table service across their venues. This is a senior front-of-house position for a career waiter with formal training or substantial experience in fine dining service, not an entry-level waiting role.

Key duties and responsibilities

•Provide polished, professional table service to premium dining standards, including formal service techniques and multi-course menu service.

•Demonstrate detailed knowledge of the menu: composition, provenance, allergens and preparation of dishes, communicated confidently to guests.

•Provide informed wine and beverage service, including recommendations and food and wine pairing, working alongside our sommeliers.

•Take and relay accurate orders, manage the timing and flow of service, and coordinate with kitchen and pass.

•Set up and maintain dining areas to premium standards, including table settings, glassware and service stations.

•Mentor and guide junior floor staff in service technique and product knowledge.

•Process payments and operate POS and reservations systems accurately.

•Comply with responsible service of alcohol, food safety and workplace health and safety requirements.

Skills and experience required

•An AQF Certificate III or higher in Hospitality (or equivalent formal front-of-house training) together with at least 12 months’ relevant experience; OR at least 2 years’ full-time relevant experience as a waiter in fine dining or premium dining venues.

•Demonstrated fine dining service skills, including formal/silver service techniques.

•Strong wine knowledge and genuine interest in food and beverage; wine qualifications (e.g. WSET) highly regarded.

•Excellent communication and guest-relations skills, with a calm, professional floor presence in high-volume service.

•A current Victorian RSA (or willingness to obtain before commencement).

How to Apply
Please submit your resume

Location: 581 Elderslie Rd, Broadmarsh, TAS 7030
Salary: $80,000 – $85,000 plus 12% superannuation.


Our client, GEARD, ELIZABETH JANE T/A PA & EJ GEARD, is a well-established farming enterprise specialising in cow farming and milk production, proudly operating in Tasmania’s vibrant agricultural sector. The business plays a vital role in supplying high-quality dairy products to local processors and distributors, ensuring sustainability and excellence at every stage of production. With deep roots in Tasmania’s farming community, the business upholds values of integrity, hard work, and commitment to animal welfare.

Through continuous improvement in farming practices and a strong focus on operational efficiency, PA & EJ GEARD has built a reputation for reliable and consistent dairy production. The business is committed to supporting regional development, providing employment opportunities, and maintaining the highest standards of milk quality and herd management.

We are currently seeking a skilled and motivated Dairy Technician to support the efficient management of dairy production activities and livestock performance. The successful candidate will be responsible for assisting in herd management, monitoring animal health and nutrition, maintaining production standards, collecting and analysing farm data, and implementing improved dairy farming practices to maximise productivity and animal welfare.

This is a key position within the organisation and requires a strong understanding of dairy production systems, livestock management practices, and agricultural technologies. The role offers an excellent opportunity to contribute directly to the ongoing success and sustainability of a progressive Tasmanian dairy enterprise.

Qualifications and Experience

-	A Diploma or higher qualification in Agriculture, Dairy Production, Animal Science, Agricultural Technology, or a related field. Three years of relevant experience may substitute for formal qualifications.
-	At least three years of relevant experience in dairy farming, livestock production, or agricultural operations.
-	Demonstrated knowledge of dairy herd management, animal nutrition, and milk production processes.
-	Experience in collecting, analysing, and maintaining farm production records and livestock data.
-	Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements and biosecurity practices in agricultural environments.

Key Responsibilities

-	Examine pasture, soil, and environmental conditions to determine their suitability for dairy production and identify factors affecting feed quality and livestock performance.
-	Assist in developing and implementing improved methods of pasture management, feeding programs, milking operations, and herd management to maximise productivity and land utilisation.
-	Monitor livestock health and identify diseases, parasites, and other conditions affecting dairy cattle, and assist in implementing appropriate control and treatment measures.
-	Analyse milk production and farm outputs to establish and maintain quality standards and production targets.
-	Inspect dairy cattle to evaluate the effectiveness of feeding programs, nutritional supplements, and herd management practices.
-	Assist in breeding and herd improvement programs aimed at enhancing milk production, animal health, and genetic performance.
-	Coordinate the supply and administration of veterinary drugs, vaccines, feed supplements, and agricultural chemicals, and provide advice on their appropriate use.
-	Collect, record, and analyse production, breeding, and animal health data to support farm planning and continuous improvement initiatives.
-	Assist in planning and coordinating milking schedules, feed management programs, livestock movements, and other aspects of dairy production operations.
-	Provide advice and recommendations to farm management regarding dairy production techniques, animal husbandry practices, and strategies to improve operational efficiency and sustainability.
-	Ensure compliance with animal welfare, biosecurity, workplace health and safety, and environmental regulations applicable to dairy farming operations.
-	Maintain accurate records relating to herd performance, milk yields, treatments, breeding activities, and farm production outcomes.

Skills and Attributes

-	Strong knowledge of dairy production systems and livestock management practices.
-	Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
-	Ability to interpret production data and implement practical improvements.
-	Good communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work effectively with farm managers, veterinarians, and suppliers.
-	Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities in a dynamic farming environment.
-	Commitment to animal welfare, workplace safety, and continuous improvement.

To apply, please attach an up-to-date resume. All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

Please send your resume to recruitment@targetbusiness.com.au.

Resource Corner IT has been working with Banking and Telecom and Federal Department to help them achieve business agility, competitive edge, and growth.

Head Office is in Norwest Business Park, Norwest NSW 2153, you will be required to work on clients' office (on multiple locations possible), depending on the engagement, whilst remaining a direct employee of Resource Corner

Job Description – Developer / Programmer

You will also be researching, consulting, analyzing and evaluating system program needs. 
You will also be involved in identifying technology limitations and deficiencies in existing systems and associated processes, procedures and methods. Furthermore, you will be required to perform testing, debugging, diagnosing and correcting errors and faults in an applications programming language within established testing protocols, guidelines and quality standards to ensure programs and applications perform to specification. 

In addition, you will be writing and maintaining program code to meet system requirements, system designs and technical specifications in accordance with quality accredited standards. 

Other Developer Programmer related responsibilities as required

· Agile ways of working

ABOUT US:
Mizar Partners Pty Ltd is an Australian professional accounting and business advisory firm with offices in Melbourne and Sydney. We provide accounting, taxation, compliance and business advisory services to individuals, sole traders, small and medium-sized businesses, and corporate clients across a wide range of industries.
Our services include bookkeeping, management accounting, taxation, tax planning, business advisory, cash flow management, SMSF support, entity structure advice, financial reporting and compliance support. We focus on providing practical accounting and taxation solutions to help clients maintain accurate financial records, meet their statutory obligations, understand their financial position and make informed business decisions.
Vacant Position: Senior Accountant 
We are seeking an experienced Accountant to join our senior level service team on a full-time basis. The successful applicant will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, analysing financial and taxation information for clients, assisting with statutory compliance, preparing financial statements and tax returns, supporting business advisory work, and providing professional accounting support across a range of client matters.
This role is suited to a professional with strong technical knowledge in accounting, taxation, financial reporting, business compliance, accounting systems, budget analysis, cash flow management and client advisory services.
Hiring Type: Permanent Full-time
Salary Range: Above AUD82,000 + super/ per year 
(The remuneration will depend on the skills, outcomes and experience you can deliver. )
Working Location: Melbourne
Qualification Requirements:
•	Above Master’s degree from Australia or overseas tertiary education provider is a must;
•	Must have a minimum of 3 years’ relevant accounting experience in public practice or business services.
•	Strong communication skills required, including proficiency in English and Mandarin.
•	Hands-on public practice experience delivering end-to-end tax, BAS and financial reporting services for Australian SME.
•	In-depth working knowledge of ATO legislation, payroll compliance, FBT, GST, PAYG and superannuation regulatory rules.
•	Strong proficiency with cloud accounting platforms and advanced Excel for financial modelling and reconciliation.
•	CPA/CA qualified or currently undertaking professional accounting accreditation will highly regarded.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian taxation law and compliance requirements.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills to deliver straightforward financial advice to non- 
financial business owners.
•	Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

Roles and Responsibility:
This is a senior level accounting service role, with core duties including:
?	Conduct payroll reviews fully compliant with ATO standards, including superannuation contribution calculations and salary packaging deduction audits.
?	Prepare month-end accounting deliverables: cash flow statements, journal entries, ad-hoc performance reports, monthly budgets, balance sheets and formal management reporting packs.
?	Prepare, reconcile and lodge all compliance documentation including Business Activity Statements (BAS), individual, company, partnership and super fund tax returns covering GST, PAYG instalments, PAYG withholding and all statutory tax obligations.
?	Design, update and refine internal financial workflows and general accounting procedures to boost operational efficiency and accuracy.
?	Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support for cloud-based accounting software systems used by internal teams and SME clients.
?	Compile complete financial statements (balance sheet, profit & loss, cash flow statements), conduct line-by-line account reviews and general ledger reconciliations, and deliver profitability, liquidity and financial health analysis to firm management and directors.
?	Prepare, validate and submit accurate annual Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) filings for all client entities.
?	Deliver customised professional taxation and structural advice to clients covering business setup,     
growth planning and daily operational financial optimisation.
?	Build robust financial control frameworks to protect client asset integrity, analyse operational expenses and track organisational income and expenditure trends.
?	Serve as the primary liaison for external auditors and support interim and year-end statutory audit procedures for all client portfolios.
?	Correspond and negotiate directly with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) and other financial regulatory authorities as required for client compliance matters.
?	Identify legitimate tax minimisation opportunities, eligible claim deductions and profit-improvement strategies for individual and business clients.

Media Account Service Roles
Trading under Publicis Media Australia
Location: Sydney or Melbourne or Brisbane

Senior Account Executive (Also known as Senior Planning Executive, Senior Client Executive)

The purpose of the Senior Planning Executive role is to autonomously plan and implement client campaigns -they are ultimately responsible for the delivery of all client activity. They will help lead the delivery of communication plans and management of digital campaigns from buying and implementation through to reporting and the delivery of holistic campaign learnings.  The Senior Planning Executive is to work in collaboration with the wider team to deliver integrated and creative plans that considers all vehicles (display, SEM, SEO, Social) and mainstream media at every possible opportunity. The Senior Planning Executive ensures attention to detail in all facets of their work and will take responsibility for any errors that occur.  Experience required: Minimum 3-4 years’ experience understanding and working knowledge of Australian Media Landscape and digital marketing advertising. Preferably a University degree or higher education qualifications. Expert understanding and working knowledge of Australian medialandscape. Expert across the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Have an understanding and experience using the following tools: eTAM, BMD, Roy Morgan, EMMA, eRAM, Nielsen Digital / Answers, Sizmek and/or DCM, MOVE, AQX Fusion 

Salary:$80 –90k package

Account Manager (Also known as Client Manager, Planning Manager, Associate Account Manager, Associate Client Manager, Associate Planning Manager)
The purpose of the Account Manager role is to create media strategy and implementation recommendations across all media for clients and oversee the delivery of all campaigns.  This role requires skills in creativity, media planning, media marketplace, tools and market dynamics. The Account Manager is also responsible for directly managing any Co-ordinators and Planning Executives within the client team and supporting the senior client leads in managing the client relationship through regular communication, presentations, WIP’s, and financial process.  Experience Required:  3-4 years’ industry experience. Expert across the following Office platforms: Word, PowerPoint and Excel. Possess sound financial management skills. Strong media understanding including an understanding and experience in using the full suite of media planning and measurement tools.
Salary: $80k-$100k package

Associate Account Director (Also known as Associate Client Director, Associate Planning Director, Senior Account Manager, Senior Planning Manager, Senior Client Manager)

This role is focused around communications planning, account service and leading a team of direct and indirect reports. For this role, we require someone who is comfortable in establishing and owning senior level client relationships and helping drive the client forward in regards to their media/marketing plans. This role also offers you the opportunity to test and learn new things allowing you to be at the forefront of new learning. The purpose of the Associate Account Director is to ensure that client service is of an exceptionally high standard. The Associate Account Director works closely with the Account Director and/or Business Director and/or Group Business Director to ensure that the product delivered to clients is best in class and in line with the agency’s values.  Experience required: 4-5 years industry experience, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client Leadership ,excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen ,strong understanding of media channels, understanding of media systems.
Salary: $90k-$110k package 

Account Director (Also known as Client Director, Planning Director)
The purpose of the Account Director is to lead the development of media strategy and communication plans across their client portfolio. They are ultimately responsible for their teams work & output. They must ensure attention to detail in all facets of their teams work and take responsibility for any errors that occur. It is expected that they will participate in, embrace and lead training forums for their team and where applicable the common good of the agency. The Account Director is also responsible for developing long-term, mutually beneficial relationships with all clients - they should look to own the Marketing Manager level client relationship, and in some instances at the Marketing Director level. Account Directors will be called on to assist or lead New Business opportunities
Salary: $100k - $130k package

Business Director (Also known as Client Partner)
This role is focused on driving client business relationship and deliver best in class business and communications solutions for clients.  The Business Director role includes: ultimate responsibility in overseeing and managing accounts, manage client expectations, anticipate client needs, resolve issues, identify client business requirements and work with team and cross functional teams to deliver the right solutions. Proactively source and present media / group solutions to help grow your client’s business 
Experience Required:  8-10 years industry experience at the minimum, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client leadership ,excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen, strong understanding of media channels understanding of media systems.
Salary – over threshold 

Group Business Director (Also known as Client Partner)
Purpose of the role is to inspire and manage the client team and specialists to deliver world class work, service and partnerships. Deliver services and products that drives marketing led growth for our clients. Develop trusted and positive senior client relationships e.g. CMO, Marketing Director and ensure the agency team is acting as a true marketing partner. Develop internal and external client action plans that: Drives you and your team to deliver against client needs in a style which makes your client consider you their most valued business partner.  Identify opportunities to deliver marketing led growth via our diversified service. Custodian of the whole client contract, scope of work and have a plan in place to safeguard any upcoming renewals/negotiations (with General Manager/Managing Director).  Experience Required:  12-15 years industry experience, people management skills, strong written and verbal communication skills , client leadership, excellent presentation skills, sound business acumen, strong understanding of media channels, understanding of media systems.
Salary – over threshold 


All of the above roles require a relevant tertiary qualification or a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in lieu of qualification.

Roles could also be available in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane

Employer:	Royal 3PL Pty Ltd t/a Northedge Cabinets and Cladding
Position: 	Office Manager 
Salary: 	       $76,000 – $85,000 Plus Superannuation
Location: 	36 Highlander Dr. Craigieburn VIC 3064
Mode: 		Full-Time
Experience:	1 year experience
Royal 3PL Pty Ltd trading as Northedge Cabinets and Cladding, is an Australian-owned company specialising in the design, manufacture, supply, and installation of premium cabinetry and architectural cladding solutions. The company delivers high-quality products and services to residential, commercial, and multi-unit developments across Australia, working closely with builders, developers, architects, designers, and private clients.
Northedge Cabinets and Cladding provides customised joinery and cabinetry solutions for kitchens, bathrooms, wardrobes, laundries, offices, and other interior spaces, together with innovative cladding systems that enhance the functionality and visual appeal of modern buildings. The company is committed to delivering tailored solutions that meet each client's design requirements while maintaining exceptional standards of workmanship, quality, and customer service.
The business manages projects from initial consultation and design through to manufacturing, project coordination, delivery, and installation. By integrating skilled craftsmanship with efficient project management and modern manufacturing techniques, Northedge Cabinets and Cladding ensures projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest industry standards.
As the company continues to expand its operations and undertake an increasing number of residential and commercial projects, it has experienced significant growth in its administrative and operational requirements. This growth has created the need for dedicated management of office operations, customer communications, project administration, supplier coordination, procurement activities, and internal business processes.
To support the continued expansion of the business, Royal 3PL Pty Ltd requires a skilled Office Manager to oversee the company's administrative functions, coordinate office operations, streamline internal processes, and provide essential support to management, production, installation teams, suppliers, and clients. The position plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of the business while enabling the company to maintain its high standards of service delivery and support its future growth objectives.
Key Responsibilities:

•	Coordinate the day-to-day administrative operations of the office to ensure efficient workflow and business continuity.
•	Develop, implement and maintain office procedures, administrative systems and record management processes to improve operational efficiency.
•	Coordinate incoming customer enquiries, prepare quotations, maintain job files and ensure project documentation is complete and up to date.
•	Liaise with clients, builders, suppliers and subcontractors regarding project schedules, material deliveries, installation dates and administrative requirements.
•	Prepare and process purchase orders, supplier invoices, customer invoices and related administrative documentation.
•	Monitor office expenditure, maintain financial records and assist management with budget tracking and monthly administrative reports.
•	Coordinate procurement of office supplies and monitor stock of administrative and operational consumables.
•	Maintain accurate records of contracts, supplier agreements, project documentation and company compliance documents.
•	Coordinate staff rosters, leave records, timesheets and other human resources administration activities.
•	Ensure office operations comply with company policies, workplace health and safety procedures and relevant legislative requirements.
•	Prepare regular administrative and operational reports for management to support business planning and decision-making.
•	Identify opportunities to improve office procedures and implement administrative process improvements to enhance productivity and customer service.
•	Provide administrative support to senior management and coordinate communication between office staff, production personnel and installation teams to ensure projects progress efficiently.
	
To be successful in this role, you must have:

•	A relevant qualification in Business Administration, Management, Office Administration, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
•	At least one year of relevant experience in an office management, administration, or operations coordination role (or as otherwise required under the relevant visa or company policy).
•	Strong knowledge of office administration procedures, document management, and business operations.
•	Excellent organisational and time management skills with the ability to prioritise multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
•	Demonstrated leadership and supervisory skills with the ability to coordinate and support administrative staff.
•	Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to liaise professionally with clients, suppliers, contractors, and internal teams.

Understand customer change request and provide schedule

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Trade Qualifications and +5 years proven relevant experience

Skilled in using hand tools, power tools, and diagnostic equipment
Strong knowledge of troubleshooting technique and problem-solving skills
Extensive knowledge of mechanical engineering designs, installations, maintenance, and repairs

Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to maintenance tasks

Head Chef – Surly's Surry Hills

Position Title: Head Chef
Reports To: General Manager
Business: Surly's Hospitality Pty Ltd
Venue: Surly's American Tavern
Location: 182 Campbell Street, Surry Hills NSW 2010
Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Salary: AUD $85,000 per annum plus statutory superannuation

Position Summary

The Head Chef is responsible for the overall leadership and management of the kitchen operations at Surly's American Tavern. This is a full-time senior management position responsible for menu development, food quality, kitchen leadership, financial performance, compliance with food safety legislation, and the efficient operation of a high-volume commercial kitchen.

The role is integral to the ongoing success of the business and requires an experienced chef capable of leading a diverse kitchen team while maintaining consistently high culinary standards, operational efficiency, and profitability.

Key Duties and Responsibilities

- Manage and oversee the daily operations of the kitchen, ensuring efficient service and consistently high food quality.
- Develop, design and implement seasonal menus, daily specials, catering packages and function menus that align with the Surly's brand.
- Plan recipes, portion sizes and menu pricing to maximise profitability while maintaining quality and consistency.
Supervise all food preparation and cooking to ensure presentation, quality, portion control and customer satisfaction standards are consistently achieved.
- Recruit, train, mentor and supervise kitchen employees including Sous Chefs, Chef de Parties, Commis Chefs, Apprentices and Kitchen Hands.
- Prepare staff rosters and allocate duties to ensure efficient kitchen operations and appropriate labour utilisation.
- Monitor labour costs, food costs, gross profit margins and kitchen productivity to achieve business budgets and financial targets.
- Order food, beverages and kitchen supplies, manage supplier relationships and negotiate purchasing where appropriate.
- Monitor inventory levels and implement stock control systems to minimise wastage and maximise profitability.
- Ensure compliance with all Food Safety Standards, HACCP principles, NSW Food Authority requirements and Work Health and Safety legislation.
- Develop, implement and continuously improve kitchen procedures, systems and operational standards.
- Coordinate preventative maintenance of kitchen equipment and arrange repairs as required.
- Work collaboratively with senior management on marketing initiatives, promotional campaigns, special events and business development opportunities.
- Monitor customer feedback and implement continuous improvements to menu offerings and kitchen performance.
- Maintain accurate records relating to stock control, food cost analysis, labour costs, wastage and kitchen performance.
- Ensure high standards of cleanliness, hygiene and food handling practices are maintained throughout the kitchen at all times.
- Foster a positive, professional and high-performing kitchen culture focused on teamwork, accountability and continuous improvement.
- Drive culinary innovation while maintaining the authentic American barbecue style and quality standards that define the Surly's brand.

Skills, Qualifications and Experience

The successful candidate will possess:

- Certificate IV in Commercial Cookery (or equivalent recognised qualification).
- A minimum of five (5) years' relevant experience in a senior chef or Head Chef position.
- Demonstrated experience managing a high-volume commercial kitchen.
- Proven leadership and people management skills with the ability to recruit, train and develop kitchen staff.
- Strong understanding of menu planning, recipe development, food costing and inventory management.
- Excellent knowledge of budgeting, labour management and cost control.
- Comprehensive understanding of Australian food safety legislation, HACCP principles and workplace health and safety requirements.
- Excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to work effectively under pressure while maintaining high standards of food quality and customer service.
- Strong commitment to continuous improvement, innovation and operational excellence.

Key Performance Outcomes

The Head Chef will be expected to:

- Deliver consistently high-quality food and presentation standards.
- Maintain food and labour costs within approved budgets.
- Lead, develop and retain a high-performing kitchen team.
- Ensure full compliance with food safety and workplace health and safety requirements.
- Support the commercial success of the business through effective menu engineering, operational efficiency and cost management.
- Contribute to the ongoing growth and reputation of Surly's American Tavern through culinary leadership and innovation.

## Technical Writer

## Position Overview

We are looking for a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Writer to join our team and produce clear, accurate, and user-friendly documentation that supports both internal operations and end-user understanding. This role is central to bridging the gap between complex technical concepts and accessible written content across a range of formats and platforms. The ideal candidate will bring strong research capabilities, excellent written communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively with subject matter experts, developers, and stakeholders. A background in a technical discipline combined with a passion for clear communication would make you an exceptional fit for this position.

## Key Responsibilities

- Research, develop, and maintain a broad range of technical documentation including user manuals, handbooks, training materials, standard operating procedures, and multimedia content

- Translate complex technical information into clear, concise, and accurate content tailored to the intended audience, whether end users, internal teams, or stakeholders

- Collaborate closely with engineers, developers, product managers, and subject matter experts to gather information and verify technical accuracy across all documentation

- Plan, organise, and manage documentation projects from initial brief through to final publication, ensuring deadlines and quality standards are consistently met

- Review and edit existing documentation to identify gaps, inconsistencies, or outdated content, and update materials to reflect product or process changes

- Develop and apply style guides, templates, and documentation standards to ensure consistency in tone, format, and terminology across all written outputs

- Produce content for digital and print formats including online help systems, knowledge bases, e-learning modules, and technical reference guides

- Liaise with stakeholders to understand documentation requirements and translate business or technical briefs into structured, reader-focused content

- Conduct quality assurance reviews of documentation prior to release, checking for technical accuracy, readability, grammar, and adherence to brand and style guidelines

- Support the development of training materials and contribute to onboarding programmes by producing clear instructional content for new users or staff

- Manage version control and document repositories, ensuring all materials are correctly filed, versioned, and accessible to relevant teams

## Required Qualifications & Skills

- Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, Technical Writing, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline

- Demonstrated experience in a technical writing role, ideally within a corporate, technology, or engineering environment

- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a high level of attention to detail and accuracy

- Proven ability to research, interpret, and document complex technical subjects in a clear and accessible manner

- Proficiency in documentation tools such as MadCap Flare, Confluence, Microsoft Word, or equivalent platforms

- Experience working with content management systems, version control tools, and document repositories

- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines

- Ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams and build effective relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Sound understanding of documentation best practices, including the use of style guides such as the Microsoft Manual of Style or equivalent

## Preferred Qualifications

- Postgraduate qualification or professional certification in Technical Communication, such as a Certificate IV in Professional Writing and Editing or equivalent

- Experience with API documentation, software development lifecycle (SDLC), or working within Agile project environments

- Familiarity with graphic design or multimedia tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Snagit, or Camtasia to support visual documentation

- Exposure to single-sourcing methodologies and structured authoring frameworks such as DITA

- Prior experience in a regulated industry such as healthcare, finance, or engineering where documentation compliance is essential

## Why Join Us?

- Flexible working arrangements including hybrid and remote options to support a healthy work-life balance

- A collaborative, inclusive team culture that values expertise, continuous learning, and professional growth

- Access to ongoing training, professional development programmes, and support for further education or industry certifications

- Meaningful work that directly contributes to product quality, customer experience, and organisational knowledge

- Competitive remuneration package with additional benefits reviewed annually in line with performance

## Job Details

- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent

- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift

- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

Skives Technologies Kalgoorlie Pty Ltd has been operating in the Goldfields region for over 11 years, establishing a strong reputation as a trusted provider of mechanical and maintenance services to the mining industry. Our team has extensive expertise in maintaining, rebuilding, and managing processing and crushing plants, we have proven extensive experience across both mobile and fixed crushing plants, including setup, commissioning, and decommissioning.

We are committed to delivering high-quality work with a strong focus on safety, reliability, and professionalism, which has enabled us to secure long term client contracts and continue expanding our team to meet growing industry demand.

We seeking an Office Manager who brings a positive attitude, strong leadership skills, and a genuine desire to become an integral part of our long term team, to provide vital processes and incorporate systems to ensure the efficient operation of the company's office and support services for our growing team. The position oversees office systems, administrative staff, workflow procedures, resource allocation, records management and operational support functions, while providing administrative leadership to support the company's mining maintenance operations and continued growth.

The Office Manager reports directly to the Directors and collaborates with operational, project and human resource personnel to maintain effective business systems, regulatory compliance and organisational efficiency.

The company's head office is located at 148 Dugan Street, Kalgoorlie WA 6430.

Duties & Responsibilities:
- Organise, coordinate and oversee the day-to-day operations of the office to ensure the efficient delivery of administrative and business support services across the company.
- Develop, implement and review office administration systems, procedures and workflows to improve operational efficiency and service standards.

- Coordinate recruitment administration, onboarding processes, induction requirements, employee records and workplace documentation in conjunction with management.
- Coordinate and monitor administrative support functions to ensure compliance with company procedures and service standards are met. Establish, maintain and review office records management systems, filing processes, databases and document control procedures. Ensure the accuracy, security and confidentiality of company records, personnel documentation and business information.
- Manage procurement activities relating to office, equipment and business resources, including monitoring inventory levels and supplier relationships.
- Coordinate office requirements and liaise with service providers to ensure reliable operation of business systems and infrastructure.
- Liaise with clients, suppliers, contractors and external stakeholders regarding administrative and operational matters.
- Coordinate required travel, accommodation and transport arrangements for all employees and contractors.
- Manage mine-site access requests, inductions and compliance documentation to ensure personnel meet client and site requirements.
- Coordinate team meetings, training activities, conference or events.
- Ensure the business activity comply with workplace health and safety requirements, company policies and relevant legislative obligations.
- Support management in implementing business initiatives, organisational improvements and continuous process enhancements to grow the business.

Required Qualifications:
- Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in business administration or related field.
- Two years’ minimum experience as an Office Manager or in a closely related office management position.
- Demonstrated experience coordinating office operations, administrative systems and organisational processes.

Necessary Skills:
- Organisational and time management skills

- Advanced computer skills, with an aptitude to learn new systems and procedures
- Hands-on experience with office machines and equipment
